problem_statement: The mDNS registration APIs (register/unregister host, service, and key) accept names without validating them. A caller can register a host, service, or key whose name is invalid as a DNS name — for example a label longer than 63 characters, an empty label produced by consecutive dots, or a name whose total length exceeds the DNS maximum — and the call does not fail. Registering or unregistering such invalid names should be rejected and return OT_ERROR_INVALID_ARGS, while well-formed names (labels 1–63 characters, total length within the DNS maximum, with a single trailing dot or a bare '.' being permitted) should be accepted. The validation is exposed through Dns::Name::ValidateLabel (for a single label) and Dns::Name::ValidateName (for a full dotted name).
